q: Read the excerpt: "Urban vertical farms cut water consumption by up to 90 percent compared with open-field agriculture, yet their reliance on artificial LED lighting keeps electricity costs prohibitive for staple grains such as wheat." What is the primary tension highlighted by the author?
opts: Abundant natural sunlight versus severe shortages of urban land
High water efficiency versus elevated energy costs for staple crops
Strict organic regulations versus declining interest in leafy greens
Lower grain quality versus rapid consumer adoption in rural areas
explanation: Matnda vertikal fermalar suvni 90% gacha tejashi, ammo sun'iy LED yoritish tufayli bug'doy kabi asosiy don ekinlari uchun elektr xarajati juda yuqori bo'lib qolishi asosiy ziddiyat sifatida ko'rsatilgan.
mnemonic: Water saving (90%) vs LED electricity cost = primary tension

q: Read the passage: "Although sleep deprivation is widely linked to impaired memory consolidation, researchers caution that self-reported sleep diaries often overestimate actual rest by nearly forty minutes." Which statement accurately reflects the methodological caution?
opts: Clinical sleep laboratories are no longer necessary for cognitive memory studies
Forty minutes of extra rest completely eliminates daytime cognitive fatigue in adults
Personal sleep logs tend to overstate true rest duration by ~40 minutes
Memory consolidation occurs strictly during the final hour of deep nighttime sleep
explanation: Muallif tadqiqotchilarning metodologik ogohlantirishini aniq ko'rsatmoqda: ishtirokchilar o'zi yozgan uyqu kundaliklari haqiqiy uyqu vaqtini taxminan 40 daqiqaga oshirib ko'rsatadi.
mnemonic: Self-reported diaries overestimate rest by ~40 min

q: Read the scientific summary: "Mycorrhizal fungi form microscopic networks beneath forest floors, trading soil phosphorus for carbon sugars synthesized by mature trees." In this context, what does the verb "trading" imply about the relationship?
opts: An accidental chemical leakage caused by decaying autumn leaves
A mutually beneficial biological exchange of vital nutrients
A competitive struggle depriving older trees of soil minerals
A seasonal parasitic cycle triggered by early winter frost
explanation: Kontekstda 'trading' fe'li zamburug'lar (fosfor beradi) va daraxtlar (uglerodli qand beradi) o'rtasidagi o'zaro foydali simbiotik modda almashinuvini anglatadi.
mnemonic: Trading phosphorus for sugars = mutually beneficial exchange

q: Read the report: "While lithium-ion batteries still dominate electric vehicles, sodium-ion alternatives are gaining commercial momentum because sodium is geologically abundant and performs more reliably in sub-zero winters." For which target audience is this passage most clearly written?
opts: General informed readers tracking clean energy technology trends
Historical archivists cataloguing nineteenth-century mining patents
Elementary pupils learning basic chemical symbols in class
Mechanical technicians repairing older diesel engines
explanation: Ilmiy-ommabop matn murakkab kimyoviy tenglamalarsiz, zamonaviy energiya texnologiyalariga qiziquvchi keng o'quvchilar auditoriyasi (nomutaxassislar) uchun tushunarli tilda yozilgan.
mnemonic: Popular science tone = general informed readers

q: Read the excerpt: "Glaciologists warn that once permafrost thaws beyond a critical threshold, trapped methane escapes into the atmosphere, accelerating warming in a self-reinforcing loop." What does "self-reinforcing loop" mean here?
opts: A laboratory technique for capturing methane inside glacial cores
A seasonal freeze cycle restoring lost permafrost every autumn
A cycle where rising heat triggers emissions that drive further warming
A natural cooling mechanism stabilizing polar temperatures rapidly
explanation: 'Self-reinforcing loop' (o'z-o'zini kuchaytiruvchi halqa / ijobiy teskari aloqa) — muz erishi metan chiqaradi, metan esa haroratni yanada ko'tarib erishni tezlashtiradi.
mnemonic: Thaw → methane → more warming → more thaw

q: Read the passage: "Early antibiotics transformed surgery by curbing lethal bacterial infections, yet decades of indiscriminate prescription in livestock and clinics have bred multidrug-resistant strains." What can be inferred about the author's attitude toward current antibiotic use?
opts: Concerned that careless overuse threatens a vital medical gain
Convinced that early antibiotics failed against surgical infections
Indifferent to whether hospitals regulate antibiotic prescriptions
Optimistic that livestock farming will rapidly curb bacterial strains
explanation: 'Indiscriminate prescription' (tartibsiz/o'ylamay buyurish) iborasi muallifning muhim tibbiy yutuq noto'g'ri foydalanish tufayli xavf ostida qolayotganidan xavotirda ekanini ko'rsatadi.

q: Read the note: "Biomimetic engineers studied kingfisher beaks to redesign high-speed train noses, reducing tunnel sonic booms by thirty percent while cutting aerodynamic drag." Which outcome was achieved through this biological inspiration?
opts: Elimination of electrified rail lines in steep mountains
Replacement of heavy steel hulls with synthetic feather composites
Quieter passage under hills alongside lower air resistance
Higher locomotive weight paired with reduced cruising speeds
explanation: Baliqchi qush tumshug'i shakli asosida poyezd burnini qayta loyihalash tunnel shovqinini 30% kamaytirgan va aerodinamik qarshilikni pasaytirgan.
mnemonic: Kingfisher beak → less sonic boom + less drag

q: Read the excerpt: "Unlike conventional plastic that persists in landfills for centuries, PHA bioplastics synthesized by marine microbes break down harmlessly into water and carbon dioxide within months." Which contrast is central to the excerpt?
opts: Consumer recycling habits versus municipal waste incineration laws
Lower manufacturing cost versus high tensile strength under heat
Rapid microbial breakdown versus centuries-long waste persistence
Freshwater algae harvesting versus deep-sea petroleum extraction
explanation: Matn an'anaviy plastikning asrlar davomida chirimasligini dengiz mikroblari sintezlagan PHA bioplastikining bir necha oyda zararsiz parchalanishi bilan qiyoslaydi.
mnemonic: Centuries in landfills vs harmless breakdown in months

q:
Match each academic reading skill with the exact analytical task it requires:
1. Skimming
2. Scanning
3. Inferencing
4. Evaluating bias A. Deducing implied meaning not directly stated on the page
B. Reading rapidly to grasp the overall gist and main theme
C. Searching quickly for a specific date, figure, or proper name
D. Assessing whether the author presents balanced evidence or slant
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Skimming) → B (Reading rapidly to grasp the overall gist and main theme); 2 (Scanning) → C (Searching quickly for a specific date, figure, or proper name); 3 (Inferencing) → A (Deducing implied meaning not directly stated on the page); 4 (Evaluating bias) → D (Assessing whether the author presents balanced evidence or slant). Skimming — umumiy g'oyani tez anglash; Scanning — aniq sana/raqam qidirish; Inferencing — ochiq aytilmagan ma'noni chiqarish; Evaluating bias — muallif xolisligini baholashdir.

q:
Arrange the standard stages of a peer-reviewed scientific article from opening to conclusion:
1. Methodology detailing experimental design, sample, and instruments
2. Results presenting empirical measurements, tables, and statistics
3. Discussion interpreting implications, limitations, and future work
4. Abstract summarizing the research question and principal findings
5. Introduction reviewing prior literature and stating the hypothesis
explanation: Ilmiy maqola xalqaro IMRaD tuzilmasiga muvofiq Abstract → Introduction → Methodology → Results → Discussion tartibida yoziladi.

q: Read the narrative excerpt: "When the ferry horn echoed through the fog, Farid gripped his battered violin case tighter; he had missed the earlier boat only because he stopped to return a dropped wallet to an elderly passenger." What can be inferred about Farid's character?
opts: He regretted helping the stranger once the coastal fog thickened
He deliberately tried to avoid attending his musical audition
He is chronically careless about schedules and public transport
He prioritizes honesty and kindness even at personal inconvenience
explanation: Farid keksa yo'lovchining tushib qolgan hamyonini qaytarish uchun oldingi kemadan kechikkan — bu uning shaxsiy noqulaylik hisobiga bo'lsa-da halollik va mehribonlikni ustun qo'yishini ko'rsatadi.
mnemonic: Returned wallet despite missing ferry = honesty over convenience

q: Read the story excerpt: "Nora unfolded the yellowed map her grandfather had tucked behind the clock; every coastal lighthouse was circled in faded blue ink except the northernmost tower, which bore a single red cross." Why does the narrator emphasize the red cross?
opts: To build suspense and mark one lighthouse as uniquely vital
To indicate that the old chart was corrected by a modern museum curator
To prove that her grandfather ran out of faded blue ink while drawing
To explain why several northern coastal lighthouses had been demolished
explanation: Barcha mayoqlar ko'k siyohda, odatda eng shimoliysi qizil xoch bilan belgilangani hikoyada intriga (suspense) yaratib, aynan shu joyning alohida ahamiyatini ko'rsatadi.
mnemonic: One red cross among blue circles = narrative suspense

q: Read the passage: "By the time the mountain rescue team reached the ridge at dawn, the hikers had already built a windbreak from dry pine branches and rationed their last thermos of tea." Which event occurred FIRST chronologically?
opts: The rescue team reached the snowy mountain ridge at sunrise
The rescue crew shared warm tea before sunrise arrived
The hikers climbed down safely into the valley with ropes
The hikers built a pine windbreak and shared their tea
explanation: 'By the time ... reached, the hikers had already built ...' (Past Perfect) qutqaruvchilar yetib kelishidan OLDIN sayyohlar shamoldan pana qurib choyni bo'lishib bo'lganini aniq bildiradi.
mnemonic: Past Perfect (had already built) = happened FIRST

q: Read the excerpt: "Though the workshop ceiling leaked whenever April storms swept across the courtyard, Master Karim refused to relocate, insisting that the acoustics of the old adobe walls gave his dutars their warm resonance." What does "resonance" refer to here?
opts: The fragile roof beams vibrating during heavy April storms
The damp smell produced by rainwater in old clay bricks
The rich, lingering acoustic quality of the dutars' sound
The high market price collectors pay for antique timber
explanation: Kontekstda 'acoustics' va 'warm resonance' iboralari ustaxonaning loy devorlari dutorlar ovoziga beradigan chuqur, jarangdor va iliq akustik jarangni bildiradi.
mnemonic: Warm resonance + acoustics = rich sound quality

q: Read the narrative: "Elena smiled politely across the conference table, yet her fingers tapped a silent, rapid rhythm beneath the tablecloth as the director announced the restructuring plan." What implicit emotion is conveyed by this contrast?
opts: Mild boredom caused by hearing a familiar weekly update
Genuine enthusiasm for taking over the director's office role
Open hostility expressed through aggressive facial gestures
Concealed nervousness masked by a composed outward expression
explanation: Yuzdagi xushmuomala tabassum bilan stol ostida barmoqlarning tez taqillashi o'rtasidagi qarama-qarshilik tashqi xotirjamlik ortiga yashirilgan ichki hayajon va xavotirni ko'rsatadi.
mnemonic: Polite smile + rapid tapping under table = hidden anxiety

q: Read the passage: "For three summers the abandoned orchard yielded only gnarled, sour apples; yet after the village schoolchildren cleared the encroaching weeds and repaired the irrigation ditch, the autumn harvest filled twenty wooden crates." What is the central theme of this passage?
opts: Synthetic fertilizers are vital for village fruit orchards
Autumn rainfall alone decides whether an orchard thrives
Patient collective care can revive neglected resources
Wild fruit trees grow stronger without human pruning
explanation: Hikoyaning asosiy g'oyasi — qarovsiz qolgan bog'ni bolalarning hamjihat mehnati va parvarishi (begona o'tlarni tozalash, ariqni tuzatish) yana serhosil qilganidir.
mnemonic: Collective care restores neglected orchard = central theme

q: Read the excerpt: "At 8:15 a.m., the conductor blew his whistle; three minutes later, the express pulled out of Platform 4, leaving Tariq standing breathless beside the ticket barrier with his unvalidated pass." How did Tariq miss the train?
opts: The express departed fifteen minutes ahead of schedule
He mistakenly boarded a regional train on Platform 2
He reached the gate too late to board before 8:18 a.m.
The conductor refused his pass because the coaches were full
explanation: 8:15 da hushtak chalingan, 3 daqiqadan so'ng (8:18 da) poyezd jo'nab ketgan, Tariq esa hali chiptasini tasdiqlatmasdan turniket oldida qolib ketgan — ya'ni kech qolgan.
mnemonic: 8:15 + 3 min = 8:18 departure; Tariq arrived too late

q: Read the scene: "After losing the regional chess final, Samira spent the evening replaying her seventh move on a pocket board until she spotted the overlooked knight fork." What does this scene reveal about Samira?
opts: She treats setbacks constructively to improve her game
She plans to quit regional chess after a single defeat
She claims her rival won through an unfair local rule
She favors rote memory over reviewing tactical mistakes
explanation: Mag'lubiyatdan tushkunlikka tushish o'rniga 7-yurishdagi xatosini darhol tahlil qilib topishi Samiraning xatolardan saboq olish va o'zini takomillashtirish xarakterini ko'rsatadi.
mnemonic: Replaying mistake after loss = constructive self-improvement

q:
Match each narrative element with its literary function in a story:
1. Exposition
2. Climax
3. Foreshadowing
4. Resolution A. The closing stage where the central conflict is settled
B. Introducing the setting, time period, and central characters
C. The moment of highest tension and decisive turning point
D. Subtle hints suggesting important events that will occur later
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Exposition) → B (Introducing the setting, time period, and central characters); 2 (Climax) → C (The moment of highest tension and decisive turning point); 3 (Foreshadowing) → D (Subtle hints suggesting important events that will occur later); 4 (Resolution) → A (The closing stage where the central conflict is settled). Exposition — boshlang'ich tanishtiruv; Climax — kulminatsion burilish nuqtasi; Foreshadowing — kelgusi voqeaga yashirin ishora; Resolution — mojaroning yakuniy yechimidir.

q:
Put the narrative events in logical chronological order from beginning to end:
1. He sketches the ancient symbols carefully in his leather notebook
2. After the storm clears, the caravan resumes its journey toward the oasis
3. A sudden sandstorm forces a caravan to seek shelter inside a canyon
4. While waiting out the wind, the guide discovers carved inscriptions on a rock
5. Weeks later, university historians confirm the sketches reveal a lost trade route
explanation: Voqealar mantiqiy-xronologik zanjiri: bo'rondan panalanish → qoya yozuvini topish → chizib olish → yo'lni davom ettirish → keyinroq olimlar tasdiqlashi.

q: Read the paragraph with an omitted sentence at [X]: "Public libraries were once viewed strictly as silent repositories for printed books. [X] Today, many municipal branches offer coding workshops, tool lending, and coworking rooms alongside traditional shelves." Which sentence best restores cohesion at [X]?
opts: Similarly, historical archives still restrict entry to fragile manuscripts.
Over the past two decades, however, their community role has expanded dramatically.
In addition, silent reading rooms remain valued among university scholars.
Consequently, most city councils voted to stop purchasing printed novels.
explanation: Oldingi gapda 'once viewed strictly as...' (o'tmish), keyingi gapda 'Today...' (bugun) kelgan. 'Over the past two decades, however...' bu ikki davr o'rtasidagi kontrast va ko'prikni mukammal tiklaydi.

q: Read the passage: "Solar panel manufacturing prices have plunged by over eighty percent since 2010. Nevertheless, grid operators still face the challenge of storing surplus afternoon power for evening peak demand." What logical relation does "Nevertheless" establish?
opts: Direct cause and effect explaining why factory costs fell since 2010
Chronological sequence detailing the stages of solar panel installation
Concession between falling prices and an unresolved hurdle
Illustrative exemplification defining what evening peak demand entails
explanation: 'Nevertheless' (shunga qaramay) bog'lovchisi narx tushishi kabi ijobiy yutuq bilan energiyani saqlash muammosi o'rtasidagi to'siqsizlik/qarama-qarshilik (concession/contrast) munosabatini ifodalaydi.

q: Read the excerpt: "Several coastal cities have restored mangrove belts along vulnerable shorelines. These dense root systems absorb storm-surge energy far more cheaply than concrete seawalls." What cohesive device links the second sentence to the first?
opts: Cataphoric substitution naming a concept explained later
Anaphoric demonstrative reference linking back to mangrove belts
Numerical listing arranging independent points in ranked order
Temporal verbal ellipsis omitting repeated auxiliaries across clauses
explanation: 'These dense root systems' ko'rsatish olmoshli birikmasi oldingi gapdagi 'mangrove belts' ga orqaga ishora qilib (anaphoric reference) matn yaxlitligini ta'minlaydi.
mnemonic: These root systems ← mangrove belts = anaphoric reference

q: Read the paragraph: "Bilingual speakers frequently switch languages depending on social setting. For instance, an engineer may debate software design in English at work yet recount childhood memories in Uzbek at home." What is the discourse function of the second sentence?
opts: Summarizing the concluding argument before shifting to a new theme
Offering a concrete illustration to clarify the opening claim
Outlining a detailed historical timeline of bilingualism in Asia
Refuting the opening claim with contradictory survey data
explanation: 'For instance' bilan boshlangan ikkinchi gap birinchi gapdagi umumiy qoidani ('switch languages') aniq hayotiy misol bilan tushuntirib beradi (exemplification).
mnemonic: For instance = concrete illustration of general claim

q: Read the draft paragraph: "(1) Regular brisk walking improves cardiovascular endurance. (2) It also lowers resting blood pressure without requiring expensive gym memberships. (3) Medieval castles were often built atop steep hills for defense. (4) Therefore, physicians recommend thirty minutes of daily walking." Which sentence breaks textual coherence?
opts: Sentence 4, because it states a routine medical conclusion
Sentence 3, because it introduces an unrelated historical topic
Sentence 1, because it frames the main claim too broadly
Sentence 2, because it adds a secondary health benefit
explanation: 1, 2 va 4-gaplar piyoda yurishning salomatlikka foydasini izchil yoritadi; 3-gap (o'rta asr qal'alari) esa matn mavzusiga deyarli aloqasiz bo'lib, yaxlitlikni (coherence) buzadi.

q: Choose the best concluding sentence for a paragraph discussing how pedestrian-only city zones boost local cafe revenue, cut exhaust fumes, and encourage safer cycling:
opts: By contrast, rural highways require wider asphalt lanes for freight trucks.
First, municipal planners must buy new traffic lights for suburban corners.
Together, these gains benefit both commerce and public health.
Historically, nineteenth-century trams were pulled by horses on iron tracks.
explanation: Yakunlovchi gap ('Together, these gains...') xatboshida keltirilgan iqtisodiy (kafe daromadi) va ekologik/sog'liq (toza havo, velosiped) foydalarni mantiqan umumlashtiradi.
mnemonic: Together, these gains = summarizes commerce + public health

q: Read the two sentences: "Prolonged drought depleted reservoir levels across the basin. [___], municipal authorities introduced tiered water rationing for residential districts." Which discourse marker accurately expresses the logical link?
opts: Meanwhile
Alternatively
Conversely
Consequently
explanation: Qurg'oqchilik suv omborlarini quritgani (sabab) shahar ma'muriyatini suv taqsimotini cheklashga (oqibat) olib kelgan — bu sabab-oqibat aloqasini 'Consequently' (natijada) aniq ifodalaydi.

q: Read the opening sentence of an essay: "While remote work promises flexible schedules and shorter commutes, its hidden cost often surfaces in weakened team mentorship." What structural role does this sentence serve?
opts: A brief transition bridging two unrelated personal anecdotes
A balanced thesis outlining both a benefit and a central problem
A factual footnote citing survey figures from a national census
A closing recommendation urging firms to ban home offices at once
explanation: Insho boshidagi 'While X, Y...' gap konstruksiyasi masofaviy ishning afzalligini ham, insho muhokama qiladigan asosiy muammoni ham ko'rsatuvchi muvozanatli tezis (thesis statement) vazifasini bajaradi.

q:
Match each discourse marker with the exact logical relationship it signals in a text:
1. Furthermore
2. Whereas
3. As a result
4. Namely A. Contrasting two distinct facts or perspectives directly
B. Adding a reinforcing point to an existing argument
C. Specifying exact items or names just mentioned generally
D. Introducing the logical consequence of a prior cause
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Furthermore) → B (Adding a reinforcing point to an existing argument); 2 (Whereas) → A (Contrasting two distinct facts or perspectives directly); 3 (As a result) → D (Introducing the logical consequence of a prior cause); 4 (Namely) → C (Specifying exact items or names just mentioned generally). Furthermore — qo'shimcha dalil (addition); Whereas — qarama-qarshilik (contrast); As a result — natija/oqibat (result); Namely — aniq sanab izohlash (specification).
mnemonic: Furthermore-add, Whereas-contrast, As a result-effect, Namely-specify

q:
Reorder the following sentences into a coherent academic paragraph on urban trees:
1. Measurements in shaded districts confirm street temperatures up to four degrees lower than treeless blocks.
2. Planting shade trees along city avenues is one of the simplest ways to cool urban heat islands.
3. In addition, transpiration from thousands of leaves releases cooling moisture into the dry air.
4. During summer afternoons, their leafy canopies block direct solar radiation from heating asphalt.
5. For these reasons, urban planners increasingly treat street greenery as essential climate infrastructure.
explanation: Yaxlit xatboshi tuzilmasi: mavzu gapi (topic sentence) → 1-mexanizm → 'In addition' (2-mexanizm) → empirik dalil → 'For these reasons' (xulosa).
mnemonic: Topic → Mechanism 1 → In addition → Evidence → For these reasons

q: Read the scientific excerpt on geothermal heat pumps: "Shallow geothermal heat pumps circulate fluid through buried loops where ground temperatures stay steady year-round, slashing winter heating bills despite high upfront drilling costs." What economic trade-off does this passage highlight?
opts: Unproven belief that geothermal heat works without winter, heating, and drilling
Lower ongoing winter heating costs versus high initial drilling expenses
Treating geothermal heat as immune to winter, heating, and drilling
Narrow claim tying geothermal heat solely to winter, heating, and drilling
explanation: Matnda geotermal nasoslar qishki isitish xarajatini keskin kamaytirishi, ammo boshlang'ich burg'ulash xarajati yuqori bo'lishi asosiy iqtisodiy murosa sifatida ko'rsatilgan.
mnemonic: Geothermal = low winter bills vs high drilling cost

q: Read the scientific excerpt on offshore wind turbines: "Floating offshore wind turbines can tap steadier deep-water gusts far from coastal views, yet saltwater corrosion forces engineers to schedule costly specialized vessel maintenance." What central challenge accompanies deep-water floating turbines?
opts: Claiming offshore wind turbines operates effectively only inside wealthy capitals
Treating offshore wind as immune to steadier, corrosion, and maintenance
Narrow claim tying offshore wind solely to steadier, corrosion, and maintenance
Steadier wind output offset by expensive corrosion maintenance at sea
explanation: Dengizdagi suzuvchi shamol turbinalari barqarorroq shamol energiyasi beradi, biroq sho'r suv korroziyasi qimmat texnik xizmatni talab qiladi.
mnemonic: Floating wind = steady gusts vs saltwater maintenance

q: Read the scientific excerpt on urban cool roofs: "Coating flat city rooftops with high-albedo white membranes reflects incoming solar radiation back into space, trimming summer air-conditioning loads by up to twenty percent in sunlit blocks." Which direct mechanism explains how cool roofs save electricity?
opts: Claiming urban cool roofs operates effectively only inside wealthy capitals
Reflecting sunlight away reduces indoor cooling demand during summer
Suggesting urban cool roofs produces immediate nationwide savings with zero risk
Assuming urban cool roofs eliminates every practical hurdle in summer
explanation: Oq yuqori albedoli tom qoplamalari quyosh nurlarini qaytarib yuborishi hisobiga yozgi konditsioner energiya sarfini 20% gacha kamaytiradi.
mnemonic: White albedo roof → reflects light → cuts AC load

q: Read the scientific excerpt on green hydrogen electrolysis: "Producing green hydrogen via renewable-powered electrolysis emits only oxygen at the plant, though storing the tiny gas molecules under extreme pressure still leaks energy." What limitation currently tempers enthusiasm for green hydrogen?
opts: Viewing decorative claims around green hydrogen electrolysis
Clean production paired with energy losses during pressurized storage
Claiming older tools outperform green hydrogen electrolysis
Assuming green hydrogen electrolysis eliminates every practical hurdle in energy
explanation: Yashil vodorod ishlab chiqarishda odatda kislorod ajralib chiqsa-da, mayda molekulalarni yuqori bosimda saqlashda energiya yo'qotilishi asosiy cheklov bo'lib qolmoqda.
mnemonic: Green H2 = clean synthesis vs storage energy loss

q: Read the scientific excerpt on agrivoltaic farming: "Installing elevated solar panels above shade-tolerant berry crops generates clean electricity while shielding delicate leaves from midday heat stress and slowing soil evaporation." What primary advantage of agrivoltaics is emphasized in the excerpt?
opts: Assuming agrivoltaic farming eliminates every practical hurdle in crops
Unproven belief that agrivoltaic farming works without crops
Simultaneous power generation and microclimate protection for crops
False promise that agrivoltaic farming replaces crops fast
explanation: Agrivoltaika (ekinlar ustiga quyosh paneli o'rnatish) bir vaqtning o'zida ham elektr energiyasi beradi, ham o'simliklarni jazirama va namlik bug'lanishidan asraydi.

q: Read the scientific excerpt on peatland carbon sinks: "Although peatlands cover barely three percent of Earth's land surface, their waterlogged soils lock away twice as much carbon as all the planet's standing forests combined." What striking ecological comparison does the author present?
opts: False promise that peatland carbon replaces peatland, carbon, and forests fast
Narrow claim tying peatland carbon solely to peatland, carbon, and forests
Treating peatland carbon as immune to peatland, carbon, and forests
Tiny global peatland area storing double the carbon of all forests
explanation: Torfzorlar quruqlikning atigi 3 foizini egallasa-da, botqoqlashgan tuprog'ida sayyoradagi barcha o'rmonlardan ikki barobar ko'p uglerod saqlaydi.

q: Read the scientific excerpt on tidal barrage power: "Unlike wind or sunshine, ocean tides follow lunar cycles predictable decades in advance, making tidal stations dependable even though estuarine dams can disrupt fish migration." Which dual perspective on tidal energy appears in the passage?
opts: Claiming tidal barrage power operates effectively only inside wealthy capitals
High lunar predictability weighed against disruption to estuarine fish
Assuming tidal barrage power eliminates every practical hurdle in estuarine
Arguing that tidal barrage power lowers measurable quality across rural regions
explanation: Qalqish elektr stansiyalari Oy sikli tufayli o'n yillar oldin aniq bashorat qilinadi, ammo daryo quyilishidagi to'g'onlar baliq migratsiyasiga xalaqit berishi mumkin.
mnemonic: Tidal power = lunar predictability vs fish disruption

q: Read the scientific excerpt on enhanced rock weathering: "Spreading finely crushed basalt across croplands accelerates natural mineral reactions that draw down atmospheric carbon dioxide while gradually releasing trace nutrients into acidic soils." Which dual benefit is attributed to spreading crushed basalt on farms?
opts: Narrow claim tying enhanced rock solely to atmospheric and carbon
Unproven belief that enhanced rock works without atmospheric and carbon
False promise that enhanced rock replaces atmospheric and carbon fast
Capturing atmospheric carbon while replenishing depleted soil minerals
explanation: Maydalangan bazaltni dalalarga sepish atmosferadan CO2 yutishini tezlashtiradi va ayni paytda kislotali tuproqni mikroelementlar bilan boyitadi.
mnemonic: Crushed basalt = CO2 drawdown + soil trace nutrients

q: Read the scientific excerpt on grid-scale iron-air batteries: "Prototype iron-air batteries rely on reversible rusting of inexpensive iron pellets to supply backup power for four consecutive days, albeit at lower round-trip efficiency than lithium cells." How do iron-air batteries compare with standard lithium cells here?
opts: Unproven belief that grid-scale iron-air works without efficiency
Ignoring key risks surrounding grid-scale iron-air batteries
False promise that grid-scale iron-air replaces efficiency fast
Multi-day low-cost storage achieved at the expense of lower efficiency
explanation: Temir-havo batareyalari arzon temir granulalari yordamida 4 kunlik zaxira quvvat beradi, biroq litiy batareyalarga qaraganda energiya qaytarish samaradorligi pastroq.
mnemonic: Iron-air = 4-day cheap backup vs lower efficiency

q: Read the scientific excerpt on cloud brightening research: "Marine cloud brightening aims to spray microscopic sea-salt droplets into coastal stratocumulus decks so they reflect extra sunlight, yet climate models warn regional rainfall could shift unpredictably." Why do scientists urge caution regarding marine cloud brightening?
opts: Potential cooling gains carry risks of unintended shifts in rainfall
Unproven belief that cloud brightening works without rainfall
Claiming older tools outperform cloud brightening research
False promise that cloud brightening replaces rainfall fast
explanation: Dengiz bulutlarini oqartirish quyosh nurini ko'proq qaytarsa-da, iqlim modellari mintaqaviy yog'ingarchilik tartibi kutilmaganda o'zgarib ketishi mumkinligidan ogohlantiradi.
mnemonic: Cloud brightening = cooling vs unpredictable rainfall shifts

q: Read the scientific excerpt on glacial meltwater rivers: "High-altitude glaciers in the Tien Shan and Pamirs act as frozen water towers, storing winter snowfall and releasing vital meltwater to Central Asian valleys during arid summers." Why does the author call mountain glaciers "frozen water towers"?
opts: False promise that glacial meltwater replaces winter fast
They retain winter snow and release water during dry summer months

4. Cognitive overload A. Monitoring whether one truly understands a paragraph
B. Connecting a new text to prior background knowledge
C. Mental bottleneck when too many cues compete at once
D. Limited short-term workspace holding active ideas
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Schema activation) → B (Connecting a new text to prior background knowledge); 2 (Working memory) → D (Limited short-term workspace holding active ideas); 3 (Metacognition) → A (Monitoring whether one truly understands a paragraph); 4 (Cognitive overload) → C (Mental bottleneck when too many cues compete at once). Kognitiv o'qish atamalari: Schema activation (oldingi bilimni uyg'otish), Working memory (ishchi xotira), Metacognition (o'z tushunishini nazorat qilish), Cognitive overload (ortiqcha yuklama).
mnemonic: Schema activation / Working memory / Metacognition / Cognitive overload

q:

q:
Match each medical-journal phrase with its precise everyday meaning:
1. Statistically significant
2. Adverse event
3. Placebo-controlled
4. Prophylactic measure A. Preventive step taken before a disease develops
B. Unlikely to have occurred merely by random chance

explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Statistically significant) → B (Unlikely to have occurred merely by random chance); 2 (Adverse event) → D (Unintended harmful side effect logged during a trial); 3 (Placebo-controlled) → C (Tested against an inactive dummy treatment for comparison); 4 (Prophylactic measure) → A (Preventive step taken before a disease develops). q:
Match each renewable-energy term with its technical definition:
1. Intermittency
2. Baseload power
3. Grid curtailment
4. Pumped hydro A. Deliberately throttling surplus renewable output on full lines
B. Pumping water uphill to store surplus energy as gravity

explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Intermittency) → C (Natural variability of solar and wind output over time); 2 (Baseload power) → D (Continuous minimum electricity supply required round the clock); 3 (Grid curtailment) → A (Deliberately throttling surplus renewable output on full lines); 4 (Pumped hydro) → B (Pumping water uphill to store surplus energy as gravity). q:
Match each academic verb with the authorial attitude it conveys:
1. Refutes
2. Speculates
3. Substantiates

B. Directly disproves a rival claim with firm evidence

explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Refutes) → B (Directly disproves a rival claim with firm evidence); 2 (Speculates) → C (Offers a tentative idea without decisive proof yet); 3 (Substantiates) → A (Supports a theory with verifiable empirical findings); 4 (Acknowledges) → D (Concedes a valid point or limitation raised by others). Akademik fe'llar ohangi: Refutes (rad etadi), Speculates (taxmin qiladi), Substantiates (isbotlaydi), Acknowledges (tan oladi).

q:
Match each evolutionary biology concept with its concise explanation:
1. Natural selection
2. Convergent evolution
3. Symbiosis
4. Genetic drift A. Better-adapted traits surviving and passing to offspring
B. Close long-term biological interaction between two species
C. Random shifts in gene frequency inside small populations

explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Natural selection) → A (Better-adapted traits surviving and passing to offspring); 2 (Convergent evolution) → D (Unrelated lineages evolving similar traits in like habitats); 3 (Symbiosis) → B (Close long-term biological interaction between two species); 4 (Genetic drift) → C (Random shifts in gene frequency inside small populations). Evolyutsion atamalar: tabiiy tanlanish, konvergent evolyutsiya, simbioz va genetik dreyf.

q:
Match each astronomy term with its observable phenomenon:

q:

q:

q:

q:
Match each archaeology tool with the evidence it uncovers:

q:

q:

explanation: To'g'ri xronologik/mantiqiy ketma-ketlik: 1) Observe an unexplained natural phenomenon carefully → 2) Formulate a clear, falsifiable hypothesis → 3) Design and execute a controlled experiment with variables logged → 4) Analyze collected measurements statistically for significance → 5) Submit findings for independent peer review and publication. Ilmiy metod zanjiri: kuzatish → faraz → nazoratli tajriba → statistik tahlil → taqriz va nashr.

q:

explanation: Gidrologik sikl: bug'lanish → bulut hosil bo'lishi → tog' qori → bahor/yoz erishi → vodiylarga oqish.

explanation: mRNK vaksina mexanizmi: yetkazish → oqsil sintezi → mRNK parchalanishi → antitanachalar → immun xotira.

q:

explanation: O'rmon yong'inidan keyingi suksessiya: kul → pioner o'tlar → butalar → yosh daraxtlar → yetuk o'rmon.

q:
Sequence the steps of double-blind randomized controlled trial evaluation:

2. Unblind the dataset to compare statistical differences fairly
3. Administer identical-looking capsules so neither side knows group

explanation: Ikki tomonlama ko'r sinov: jalb qilish → randomizatsiya → bir xil kapsula → natija yig'ish → kodni ochib tahlil qilish.

q:
Order the stages of carbon capture through enhanced basalt weathering:

5. Spread the basalt powder evenly across acidic croplands
explanation: Bazalt nurashi orqali CO2 yutish: maydalash → dalaga sepish → yomg'ir kislotasi → bikarbonat reaksiyasi → okeanda uzoq saqlash.

q:
Arrange the life cycle of a peer-reviewed scientific manuscript:
1. Authors revise experiments and text to address reviewer critiques
2. Independent domain experts evaluate methods and statistics blindly
3. Accepted article undergoes copyediting and formal publication
4. Authors draft the manuscript following journal formatting rules
5. Chief editor screens the paper for scope and basic rigor
explanation: To'g'ri xronologik/mantiqiy ketma-ketlik: 1) Authors draft the manuscript following journal formatting rules → 2) Chief editor screens the paper for scope and basic rigor → 3) Independent domain experts evaluate methods and statistics blindly → 4) Authors revise experiments and text to address reviewer critiques → 5) Accepted article undergoes copyediting and formal publication. Ilmiy maqola nashr yo'li: yozish → muharrir ko'rigi → ko'r taqriz → tuzatish → nashr.

q:
Sequence how seismic early-warning networks protect urban railways:

explanation: Zilziladan erta ogohlantirish: yoriq → tez P-to'lqin → hisoblash → radio ogohlantirish → poyezdlarni to'xtatish.

q:

5. Selective attention focuses on new information during a lesson
explanation: Xotira mustahkamlanishi: diqqat → ishchi xotira → intervalli takror → uyqu konsolidatsiyasi → uzoq muddatli eslash.

q:
Arrange the workflow of airborne LiDAR archaeological discovery:
1. Equip a small survey aircraft with rapid-pulse laser scanners
2. Dispatch ground archaeologists to verify and excavate mapped sites
3. Fly systematic overlapping strips across dense tropical jungle

q:

5. Heavy rain falls onto permeable sidewalks and planted rooftops
explanation: Gubka-shahar suv aylanishi: yomg'ir → g'ovak yo'lak/yashil tom → ildiz/qum filtri → yerosti hovuz → yozda sug'orish.

q:
Order the process of producing green hydrogen from renewable energy:

explanation: Yashil vodorod ishlab chiqarish: qayta tiklanuvchi elektr → toza suv → elektroliz → kislorod ajralishi → vodorodni qo'llash.

q:

q: Read the narrative excerpt (late-night light): "Walking home past midnight, Sherzod spotted the amber glow still burning in his chemistry teacher's lab and realized why graded notebooks always arrived by dawn." What realization dawns on Sherzod outside the school?
opts: Fierce territorial pride dividing old friends throughout late-night light

q:
Match each narrative point of view with its grammatical hallmark:
1. First-person narrator
2. Third-person limited
3. Third-person omniscient
4. Unreliable narrator A. Knows the hidden thoughts and motives of every character
B. Tells events directly through "I" with subjective insight
C. Presents biased or flawed claims readers must question
D. Follows "he/she" restricted to one character's inner mind
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (First-person narrator) → B (Tells events directly through "I" with subjective insight); 2 (Third-person limited) → D (Follows "he/she" restricted to one character's inner mind); 3 (Third-person omniscient) → A (Knows the hidden thoughts and motives of every character); 4 (Unreliable narrator) → C (Presents biased or flawed claims readers must question). Hikoya nuqtayi nazarlari: 1-shaxs ('I'), 3-shaxs cheklangan (bitta qahramon fikri), 3-shaxs hamma narsani biluvchi va ishonchsiz roviy.
mnemonic: First-person narrator / Third-person limited / Third-person omniscient / Unreliable narrator

explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Flashback) → D (A scent of rain pulls the hero back to childhood); 2 (Foreshadowing) → A (A cracked balcony beam creaks twice before the gala); 3 (Symbolism) → C (A dandelion pushing through asphalt stands for resilience); 4 (Dramatic irony) → B (Readers spot the storm warning ignored by the boaters). C. Opposing force creating central obstacles for the hero

explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Protagonist) → A (Central figure driving the main quest and growth arc); 2 (Antagonist) → C (Opposing force creating central obstacles for the hero); 3 (Mentor) → D (Experienced guide offering wisdom or crucial training); 4 (Foil) → B (Contrasting peer highlighting the hero's key traits). Qahramon turlari: Protagonist (bosh qahramon), Antagonist (qarshi kuch), Mentor (ustoz), Foil (qiyosiy qarama-qarshi obraz).

q:
Match each tone adjective with the emotional flavor it creates:
1. Nostalgic
2. Foreboding
3. Wry
4. Jubilant A. Warmly longing for cherished places or times gone by
B. Dryly amused with subtle, understated verbal irony
C. Bursting with triumphant joy and bright celebration
D. Signaling looming danger or unsettling suspense ahead
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Nostalgic) → A (Warmly longing for cherished places or times gone by); 2 (Foreboding) → D (Signaling looming danger or unsettling suspense ahead); 3 (Wry) → B (Dryly amused with subtle, understated verbal irony); 4 (Jubilant) → C (Bursting with triumphant joy and bright celebration). Badiiy ohanglar: Nostalgic (sog'inchli), Foreboding (xavotirli), Wry (yengil kinoyali), Jubilant (tantanali quvnoq).

q:
Match each plot stage on Freytag's pyramid with its narrative job:
1. Inciting incident
2. Rising action
3. Climax
4. Denouement A. Closing calm tying loose threads after conflict ends
B. Escalating trials and choices raising dramatic stakes
C. Peak emotional confrontation changing the hero's fate
D. Opening spark that disrupts normal life and starts the plot
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Inciting incident) → D (Opening spark that disrupts normal life and starts the plot); 2 (Rising action) → B (Escalating trials and choices raising dramatic stakes); 3 (Climax) → C (Peak emotional confrontation changing the hero's fate); 4 (Denouement) → A (Closing calm tying loose threads after conflict ends). Syujet piramidasi: tugun (inciting), rivojlanish (rising), kulminatsiya (climax) va yakuniy yechim (denouement).
mnemonic: Inciting incident / Rising action / Climax / Denouement

q:
Match each characterization method with how readers learn about a figure:
1. Direct statement
2. Dialogue choice
3. Body language
4. Private actions A. Tapping fingers under a table expose concealed anxiety
B. Tone and phrasing reveal education, warmth, or tension
C. Narrator explicitly labels the character generous or shy
D. Unseen kindness when nobody watches proves true values
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Direct statement) → C (Narrator explicitly labels the character generous or shy); 2 (Dialogue choice) → B (Tone and phrasing reveal education, warmth, or tension); 3 (Body language) → A (Tapping fingers under a table expose concealed anxiety); 4 (Private actions) → D (Unseen kindness when nobody watches proves true values). Xarakter ochish usullari: to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ta'rif, nutq uslubi, tana tili va yashirin xatti-harakat.
mnemonic: Direct statement / Dialogue choice / Body language / Private actions

q:
Match each narrative time marker with the chronological relation it signals:
1. Meanwhile
2. Previously
3. Shortly afterward
4. Eventually A. An immediate consequence occurring moments later
B. Two separate scenes unfolding at the exact same moment
C. An earlier background event completed before the scene
D. A long-delayed outcome reached after prolonged effort
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Meanwhile) → B (Two separate scenes unfolding at the exact same moment); 2 (Previously) → C (An earlier background event completed before the scene); 3 (Shortly afterward) → A (An immediate consequence occurring moments later); 4 (Eventually) → D (A long-delayed outcome reached after prolonged effort). Vaqt belgilari: Meanwhile (bir paytda), Previously (ilgari), Shortly afterward (darhol keyin), Eventually (oxir-oqibat).

q:
Match each figurative device with its vivid story illustration:
1. Simile
2. Metaphor
3. Personification
4. Hyperbole A. The creaking elevator groaned as though enduring martyrdom
B. He had told that same fishing story a million times
C. Shadows stretched like thin fingers across the pine trail
D. The old bazaar was a living mosaic of spice and song
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Simile) → C (Shadows stretched like thin fingers across the pine trail); 2 (Metaphor) → D (The old bazaar was a living mosaic of spice and song); 3 (Personification) → A (The creaking elevator groaned as though enduring martyrdom); 4 (Hyperbole) → B (He had told that same fishing story a million times). Tasviriy vositalar: Simile (like/as o'xshatish), Metaphor (yashirin o'xshatish), Personification (jonlantirish), Hyperbole (mubolag'a).

q:
Match each setting function with its impact on a narrative:
1. Mood builder
2. Plot obstacle
3. Cultural anchor
4. Character mirror A. A frozen mountain pass forces climbers to alter routes
B. A cluttered sunlit workshop reflects an inventor's mind
C. Foggy silent docks immediately trigger unease and suspense
D. Samarkand adobe courtyards ground authentic daily customs
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Mood builder) → C (Foggy silent docks immediately trigger unease and suspense); 2 (Plot obstacle) → A (A frozen mountain pass forces climbers to alter routes); 3 (Cultural anchor) → D (Samarkand adobe courtyards ground authentic daily customs); 4 (Character mirror) → B (A cluttered sunlit workshop reflects an inventor's mind). Makon-zamon (setting) vazifalari: kayfiyat yaratish, syujet to'sig'i, madaniy muhit va qahramon ko'zgusi.
mnemonic: Mood builder / Plot obstacle / Cultural anchor / Character mirror

q:
Match each dialogue punctuation/tag cue with its expressive reading:
1. Whispered
2. Retorted
3. Mused
4. Exclaimed A. Spoke thoughtfully aloud while pondering an idea
B. Spoke softly out of secrecy, reverence, or fear
C. Cried out loudly in sudden surprise or excitement
D. Replied sharply and quickly to challenge a remark
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Whispered) → B (Spoke softly out of secrecy, reverence, or fear); 2 (Retorted) → D (Replied sharply and quickly to challenge a remark); 3 (Mused) → A (Spoke thoughtfully aloud while pondering an idea); 4 (Exclaimed) → C (Cried out loudly in sudden surprise or excitement). Dialog fe'llari: Whispered (pichirladi), Retorted (keskin javob qaytardi), Mused (o'ylanib dedi), Exclaimed (xitob qildi).

q:
Match each narrative ending style with its reader effect:
1. Resolved ending
2. Open ending
3. Twist ending
4. Circular ending A. Delivers a sudden revelation reframing earlier clues
B. Answers every central question with satisfying closure
C. Leaves final outcomes ambiguous to spark reader reflection
D. Returns to the opening image showing how the hero grew
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Resolved ending) → B (Answers every central question with satisfying closure); 2 (Open ending) → C (Leaves final outcomes ambiguous to spark reader reflection); 3 (Twist ending) → A (Delivers a sudden revelation reframing earlier clues); 4 (Circular ending) → D (Returns to the opening image showing how the hero grew). Hikoya yakuni turlari: yakunlangan (resolved), ochiq (open), kutilmagan burilishli (twist) va halqasimon (circular).
mnemonic: Resolved ending / Open ending / Twist ending / Circular ending

q:
Match each irony type in fiction with its exact definition:
1. Verbal irony
2. Situational irony
3. Dramatic irony
4. Cosmic irony A. Speaker says the opposite of what they genuinely mean
B. Audience knows a vital secret hidden from characters
C. Fate mocks human plans despite careful preparation
D. Actual outcome sharply contradicts reasonable expectation
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Verbal irony) → A (Speaker says the opposite of what they genuinely mean); 2 (Situational irony) → D (Actual outcome sharply contradicts reasonable expectation); 3 (Dramatic irony) → B (Audience knows a vital secret hidden from characters); 4 (Cosmic irony) → C (Fate mocks human plans despite careful preparation). Kinoya turlari: og'zaki (verbal), vaziyatli (situational), dramatik (dramatic) va taqdir kinoyasi (cosmic).
mnemonic: Verbal irony / Situational irony / Dramatic irony / Cosmic irony

q:
Match each verb tense in storytelling with its primary narrative job:
1. Past Simple
2. Past Continuous
3. Past Perfect
4. Historical Present A. Moves the main chain of completed plot events forward
B. Creates vivid immediacy as though unfolding right now
C. Paints ongoing background scenery interrupted by action
D. Steps backward to clarify an event completed earlier
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Past Simple) → A (Moves the main chain of completed plot events forward); 2 (Past Continuous) → C (Paints ongoing background scenery interrupted by action); 3 (Past Perfect) → D (Steps backward to clarify an event completed earlier); 4 (Historical Present) → B (Creates vivid immediacy as though unfolding right now). Hikoya zamonlari: Past Simple (asosiy voqea), Past Continuous (fon), Past Perfect (oldingi voqea), Historical Present (jonli ta'sir).
mnemonic: Past Simple / Past Continuous / Past Perfect / Historical Present

q:
Match each short-story subgenre with its defining hallmark:
1. Fable
2. Memoir excerpt
3. Mystery tale
4. Coming-of-age story A. True personal episode recalled through reflective memory
B. Brief tale often using animals to convey a clear moral
C. Chronicles a young hero gaining maturity through trials
D. Puzzle narrative structured around clues and discovery
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Fable) → B (Brief tale often using animals to convey a clear moral); 2 (Memoir excerpt) → A (True personal episode recalled through reflective memory); 3 (Mystery tale) → D (Puzzle narrative structured around clues and discovery); 4 (Coming-of-age story) → C (Chronicles a young hero gaining maturity through trials). Hikoya janrlari: masal (fable), xotira (memoir), detektiv/sir (mystery) va ulg'ayish hikoyasi (coming-of-age).
mnemonic: Fable / Memoir excerpt / Mystery tale / Coming-of-age story

q:
Match each implicit cue with the emotion it typically signals in fiction:
1. Clenched jaw
2. Dropped shoulders
3. Averted gaze
4. Brisk stride A. Suppressed anger or tight determination under stress
B. Sudden relief or defeat releasing stored bodily tension
C. Confident energy and purposeful momentum forward
D. Shyness, guilt, or discomfort avoiding direct eye contact
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Clenched jaw) → A (Suppressed anger or tight determination under stress); 2 (Dropped shoulders) → B (Sudden relief or defeat releasing stored bodily tension); 3 (Averted gaze) → D (Shyness, guilt, or discomfort avoiding direct eye contact); 4 (Brisk stride) → C (Confident energy and purposeful momentum forward). Yashirin tana tili belgilari: tishni qisish (g'azab/qat'iyat), yelka tushishi (yengillik/tushkunlik), ko'z olib qochish (uyat/noqulaylik), dadil qadam (ishonch).
mnemonic: Clenched jaw / Dropped shoulders / Averted gaze / Brisk stride

q:
Match each story theme statement with its matching plot summary:
1. Perseverance pays off
2. Appearances deceive
3. Kindness ripples onward
4. Pride precedes a fall A. Forty cracked clay bowls precede one ringing masterpiece
B. A lent bus fare returns twenty years later as free bread
C. A boastful guide ignores warnings and gets lost quickly
D. A plain chipped box holds a priceless historic compass
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Perseverance pays off) → A (Forty cracked clay bowls precede one ringing masterpiece); 2 (Appearances deceive) → D (A plain chipped box holds a priceless historic compass); 3 (Kindness ripples onward) → B (A lent bus fare returns twenty years later as free bread); 4 (Pride precedes a fall) → C (A boastful guide ignores warnings and gets lost quickly). Mavzu va syujet mosligi: matonat samarasi, tashqi ko'rinish aldamchiligi, ezgulikning qaytishi va kibrning oqibati.
mnemonic: Perseverance pays off / Appearances deceive / Kindness ripples onward / Pride precedes a fall

q:
Match each sensory imagery category with its vivid narrative phrase:
1. Visual imagery
2. Auditory imagery
3. Olfactory imagery
4. Tactile imagery A. Pale rose twilight brushing jagged snowfields
B. Warm scent of toasted cumin and rain-wet clay
C. Wooden cart wheels rattling sharply over cobbles
D. Rough adobe plaster chilled by midnight frost
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Visual imagery) → A (Pale rose twilight brushing jagged snowfields); 2 (Auditory imagery) → C (Wooden cart wheels rattling sharply over cobbles); 3 (Olfactory imagery) → B (Warm scent of toasted cumin and rain-wet clay); 4 (Tactile imagery) → D (Rough adobe plaster chilled by midnight frost). Sensor obrazlar: ko'rish (visual), eshitish (auditory), hid bilish (olfactory) va teri/tegish hissi (tactile).
mnemonic: Visual imagery / Auditory imagery / Olfactory imagery / Tactile imagery

q:
Match each pacing technique with its effect on reader experience:
1. Short crisp sentences
2. Long flowing clauses
3. Chapter cliffhanger
4. Quiet pause scene A. Slows tempo for serene landscapes or deep reflection
B. Gives breathing room after intense action to process feeling
C. Accelerates heartbeat during chases or sudden crises
D. Halts at peak uncertainty so readers turn pages eagerly
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Short crisp sentences) → C (Accelerates heartbeat during chases or sudden crises); 2 (Long flowing clauses) → A (Slows tempo for serene landscapes or deep reflection); 3 (Chapter cliffhanger) → D (Halts at peak uncertainty so readers turn pages eagerly); 4 (Quiet pause scene) → B (Gives breathing room after intense action to process feeling). Hikoya sur'ati (pacing): qisqa keskin gaplar (tezlik), uzun ravon gaplar (sokinlik), cliffhanger (intriga) va tin olish sahnasi.
mnemonic: Short crisp sentences / Long flowing clauses / Chapter cliffhanger / Quiet pause scene

q:
Match each critical reading question for narratives with what it verifies:
1. Who tells the story?
2. What changed by the end?
3. Why include this detail?
4. What remains unsaid? A. Tracing the protagonist's character arc and theme
B. Identifying narrator perspective and potential bias
C. Spotting symbolism, foreshadowing, or mood craft
D. Making grounded inferences from subtle subtext
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Who tells the story?) → B (Identifying narrator perspective and potential bias); 2 (What changed by the end?) → A (Tracing the protagonist's character arc and theme); 3 (Why include this detail?) → C (Spotting symbolism, foreshadowing, or mood craft); 4 (What remains unsaid?) → D (Making grounded inferences from subtle subtext). Voqeaband matnni tahlil qilish savollari: roviy nuqtayi nazari, qahramon evolyutsiyasi, badiiy detal vazifasi va yashirin tagma'no.
mnemonic: Who tells the story? / What changed by the end? / Why include this detail? / What remains unsaid?

q:
Order the events of the lost heirloom watch story chronologically:
1. Grandfather misplaces his silver watch while pruning the orchard
2. He rinses the mud off and recognizes his grandfather's engraved initials
3. Winter snow covers the fallen leaves around the apricot trunks
4. In April, young Timur spots a metallic glint while digging an irrigation ditch
5. That evening the whole family celebrates as the repaired watch ticks again
explanation: Soat hikoyasi xronologiyasi: yo'qolishi → qishki qor → aprelda topilishi → yozuvni tanish → oilaviy shodiyona.

q:
Arrange the narrative steps of a student's first regional debate tournament:
1. During the opening regional round, she freezes briefly before finding her voice
2. She spends autumn evenings practicing clear rebuttals with teammates
3. Nargiza nervously signs up for the school English debate club in September
4. Returning home with a bronze plaque, she volunteers to mentor younger pupils
5. By the semifinal, she delivers a poised speech praised by all three judges
explanation: Debat hikoyasi: yozilish → kuzgi mashq → ilk raund hayajoni → yarim final muvaffaqiyati → yoshlarga ustozlik.

q:
Put the mountain storm rescue narrative in exact chronological order:
1. Back in the valley lodge, the hikers donate new trail maps to the ranger station
2. Dark thunderheads roll swiftly over the ridge by early afternoon
3. Clear morning skies tempt two day-hikers past the marked timberline
4. Soaked and chilled, the hikers blow their emergency whistles inside a cave
5. Local rangers triangulate the whistle echoes and bring dry thermal cloaks
explanation: Tog' qutqaruvi: ochiq tong → tushki bulut → g'orda hushtak → qutqaruvchilar topishi → vodiyda xarita hadyasi.

q:
Sequence the restoration tale of a forgotten village library:
1. Local carpenters mend the rafters while teenagers dry damp novels in the sun
2. On reopening day, sixty children check out books before noon
3. Heavy spring rains damage the roof of the town's tiny reading room
4. Neighbors donate spare wooden shelves and freshly painted reading lamps
5. Retired librarian Karim organizes a weekend meeting on the library steps
explanation: Kutubxona tiklanishi: yomg'ir zarari → yig'ilish → tom va kitoblarni quritish → javon/chiroq hadyasi → tantanali ochilish.

q:
Order the plot of the violinist's snowy journey to the recital:
1. Halfway across the bridge, a kindly baker offers her a lift in his delivery van
2. Her quartet's soaring finale earns a standing ovation from the packed hall
3. An unexpected blizzard halts city buses two hours before the concert
4. She rushes backstage with five minutes to warm her chilled fingers
5. Determined not to miss her quartet, Laylo sets out on foot with her case
explanation: Qorli konsert safari: bo'ron avtobusni to'xtatdi → piyoda yo'l → novvoy yordami → barmoqlarni isitish → olqishli final.

q:
Arrange the chronological storyline of the mysterious antique map:
1. Curators confirm the chart marks a forgotten sixteenth-century stone bridge
2. City archaeologists excavate the dry riverbed indicated on the map
3. He brings the parchment to the university archive for expert verification
4. Restored stone arches later become the centerpiece of a new riverside park
5. While clearing an attic trunk, Aziz uncovers a faded map of old canal gates
explanation: Qadimgi xarita hikoyasi: chordoqdan topilish → arxiv tekshiruvi → XVI asr ko'prigi tasdig'i → qazishma → daryo bo'yi bog'i.

q:
Sequence the story of a shy coder building a neighborhood bus app:
1. Eleventh-grader Sardor logs bus arrival times at three stops for a month
2. By February, commuters check the free tracker daily before stepping outside
3. Elderly neighbors complain they wait in winter frost unsure when buses arrive
4. He writes a simple web tracker showing live countdowns in large bold text
5. A local transit driver shares the link across the entire district route
explanation: Avtobus ilovasi hikoyasi: muammo → bir oylik kuzatuv → kod yozish → haydovchi ulashishi → tuman bo'ylab foydalanish.

q:
Order the narrative arc of the ceramic bowl competition:
1. Refusing to quit, he spends the night crafting a delicate gold-lacquer seam
2. Apprentice Dilshod enters his first glazed bowl in the Rishtan youth exhibition
3. Judges admire how his repair turned a flaw into a striking design feature
4. He wins the special craftsmanship award for creative resilience
5. During transport, a sudden pothole chips the rim of his prized entry
explanation: Kulolchilik tanlovi: ko'rgazmaga tayyorlash → yo'lda sinishi → tunda zarhal yamoq → hakamlar e'tirofi → maxsus mukofot.

q:
Arrange the sequence of the stray falcon's recovery story:
1. Once flight tests prove strong, rangers drive the bird back to the foothills
2. Released into crisp autumn wind, the falcon circles once and vanishes skyward
3. He phones the regional wildlife clinic and wraps the bird in a soft towel
4. Veterinarians free the nylon twine and care for the falcon for three weeks
5. A farmer discovers a young falcon with a tangled wing beside his fence
explanation: Lochin qutqaruvi: topilishi → klinikaga yetkazish → 3 hafta davolash → parvoz sinovi → tabiatga qo'yib yuborish.

q:
Sequence the tale of two neighbors reviving a neglected courtyard fountain:
1. Young architect Madina sketches a simple low-energy recirculating pump plan
2. Retired plumber Bobur clears the rusted pipework over two sunny Saturdays
3. Families plant fragrant mint and lavender around the freshly tiled rim
4. Decades of fallen leaves clog the stone basin in the apartment courtyard
5. Summer evenings soon fill again with splashing water and neighborly conversation
explanation: Favvora hikoyasi: barglar to'lishi → loyiha chizmasi → quvurni tozalash → yalpiz ekish → yozgi jonlanish.

q:
Order the storyline of the misplaced manuscript in the train café:
1. A year later, the printed book carries a warm dedication to the station café
2. Relieved Hamid arrives on the afternoon train to reclaim his unfinished novel
3. Finding a publisher's bookmark inside, she phones the press office at sunrise
4. Author Hamid accidentally leaves his handwritten notebook beside a café teacup
5. Waitress Malika spots the leather binder while wiping the table before closing
explanation: Yo'qolgan qo'lyozma: kafeda qolib ketishi → ofitsiant topishi → nashriyotga qo'ng'iroq → qaytib olish → kitobdagi bag'ishlov.

q:
Arrange the plot events of the solar-powered village school project:
1. Technicians install panels during spring break as pupils watch eagerly
2. Next winter, brightly lit classrooms host thriving coding and English clubs
3. Frequent winter power cuts interrupt evening study in a remote mountain school
4. Former graduates crowdfund the battery storage pack within three weeks
5. Physics teacher Alisher drafts a grant proposal for rooftop solar panels
explanation: Quyoshli maktab hikoyasi: elektr uzilishi → grant loyihasi → bitiruvchilar yordami → o'rnatish → yorug' qishki to'garaklar.

q:
Sequence the narrative of a grandfather learning video calls:
1. Neighboring teen Otabek prints large visual icon cards for each tablet step
2. After three patient practice afternoons, grandfather dials London by himself
3. His granddaughter holds up her autumn campus window live across the screen
4. When his granddaughter moves abroad for university, grandfather feels distant
5. Every Sunday thereafter begins with shared virtual tea across four time zones
explanation: Videoqo'ng'iroq hikoyasi: sog'inch → katta kartochkalar → 3 kunlik mashq → ilk jonli suhbat → har yakshanba virtual choy.

q: Read the paragraph on urban cycling with an omitted sentence at [X]: "Protected bike lanes initially drew complaints from shopkeepers worried about fewer curbside parking spaces. [X] Within a year, however, local retail receipts climbed as cyclists paused readily for coffee and groceries." Which sentence best restores logical cohesion at [X]?
opts: By contrast, nineteenth-century mills lacked plans for urban cycling.
Business owners feared losing driving customers would empty their storefronts.
Conversely, unrelated coastal ports avoided urban cycling completely.
Historically, older archives rarely discussed urban cycling in print.
explanation: Oldingi gapda do'konchilarning avtoturargoh haqidagi xavotiri, keyingi gapda 'however' orqali daromad oshgani kelgan — [X] bu xavotir sababini mantiqan izohlaydi.
mnemonic: Complaints → [feared losing customers] → however receipts rose

q: Read the paragraph on sleep and teens with an omitted sentence at [X]: "Many secondary schools still ring opening bells shortly after seven in the morning. [X] Shifting first period back by just forty-five minutes has consistently improved attendance and alert participation." Which sentence best restores logical cohesion at [X]?
opts: Accordingly, distant harbor pilots reviewed tidal charts unrelated to sleep and teens.
Moreover, coastal lighthouse crews polished glass lenses outside sleep and teens.
Alternatively, small antique shops catalogued diaries independent of sleep and.
Yet adolescent biological clocks naturally shift toward later bedtimes and later waking.
explanation: Birinchi gapda erta qo'ng'iroq, uchinchi gapda 45 daqiqa surish foydasi berilgan — [X] 'Yet' orqali o'smirlar biologik soati bilan ziddiyatni bog'laydi.
mnemonic: 7 a.m. bells → [Yet teen bio-clocks later] → 45m shift helps

q: Read the paragraph on soil health with an omitted sentence at [X]: "Intensive deep plowing was once celebrated as the quickest way to prepare seedbeds each spring. [X] Consequently, progressive agronomists now promote minimal-till methods that preserve subterranean fungal webs." Which sentence best restores logical cohesion at [X]?
opts: Conversely, unrelated maritime workshops focused strictly on older timber crafts rather than soil health.
Meanwhile, neighboring mountain observatories tracked seasonal starlight patterns separate from soil health.
Historically, distant provincial archives rarely mentioned modern projects concerning soil health at all.
Over decades, however, repeated turning exposed fragile topsoil to wind erosion and moisture loss.
explanation: O'tmishdagi chuqur shudgor ('once celebrated') va bugungi 'Consequently' minimal shudgor o'rtasida [X] salbiy oqibatni ochib ko'prik quradi.
mnemonic: Once celebrated → [However, erosion & water loss] → Consequently no-till

q: Read the paragraph on handwritten letters with an omitted sentence at [X]: "Instant messaging delivers announcements across oceans in less than a second. [X] Psychologists find that recipients keep hand-addressed envelopes for decades precisely because ink reveals unhurried care." Which sentence best restores logical cohesion at [X]?
opts: Nevertheless, a handwritten note still carries emotional weight that digital pings rarely replicate.
Consequently, coastal weather stations archived wind-vane records independently of local handwritten shifts.
In addition, retired postal historians compiled nineteenth-century rail timetables outside handwritten.
Accordingly, distant harbor pilots reviewed tidal charts unrelated to handwritten letters.
explanation: Tezkor messenjer va uzoq saqlanadigan qo'lyozma xat o'rtasida 'Nevertheless' bilan kontrastli ko'prik [X] yaxlitlikni tiklaydi.
mnemonic: Instant chat → [Nevertheless, handwritten weight] → kept for decades

q: Read the paragraph on city trees with an omitted sentence at [X]: "Shade avenues cool summer pavements by blocking direct afternoon sunlight. [X] Together, both canopy shade and leaf evaporation lower block temperatures by up to four degrees." Which sentence best restores logical cohesion at [X]?
opts: In addition, moisture released through leaf pores acts like natural evaporative air conditioning.
Meanwhile, neighboring mountain observatories tracked seasonal starlight patterns separate from city trees.
Historically, distant provincial archives rarely mentioned modern projects concerning city trees at all.
Conversely, unrelated maritime workshops focused strictly on older timber crafts rather than city trees.
explanation: 'Together, both canopy shade and leaf evaporation...' iborasi [X] o'rnida aynan barg bug'lanishi (leaf evaporation) tilga olinishini talab qiladi!
mnemonic: Shade + [In addition, leaf moisture] → Together both cool

q: Read the paragraph on ancient paper with an omitted sentence at [X]: "Papermakers in medieval Samarkand refined linen and mulberry fibers into smooth, gleaming sheets. [X] Scholars from Baghdad to Cordoba therefore sought Samarkand paper for priceless manuscripts." Which sentence best restores logical cohesion at [X]?
opts: Conversely, unrelated maritime workshops focused strictly on older timber crafts rather than sheets.
Unlike fragile papyrus, these dense rag sheets resisted cracking and absorbed ink without smudging.
Historically, distant provincial archives rarely mentioned modern projects concerning ancient paper at all.
Consequently, coastal weather stations archived wind-vane records independently of local sheets shifts.
explanation: 'Therefore' sababli xulosadan oldin [X] Samarqand qog'ozining chidamlilik va siyoh yutish afzalligini tushuntirib beradi.
mnemonic: Samarkand paper → [resisted cracking & smudging] → therefore sought

q: Read the paragraph on museum audio with an omitted sentence at [X]: "Crowded audio-guide headsets often isolate family members inside separate bubbles during gallery tours. [X] As a result, parents and children discuss paintings aloud instead of walking silently apart." Which sentence best restores logical cohesion at [X]?
opts: Historically, distant provincial archives rarely mentioned modern projects concerning museum audio at all.
Meanwhile, neighboring mountain observatories tracked seasonal starlight patterns separate from museum audio.
Conversely, unrelated maritime workshops focused strictly on older timber crafts rather than museum audio.
To restore shared conversation, several museums now place short listening benches between exhibits.
explanation: 'As a result, parents and children discuss...' natijasidan oldin [X] o'sha muloqotni tiklovchi muqobil yechimni (listening benches) kiritadi.
mnemonic: Headsets isolate → [listening benches restore talk] → As a result discuss

q: Read the paragraph on remote teamwork with an omitted sentence at [X]: "Distributed software teams can recruit top programmers regardless of city or time zone. [X] Without structured weekly overlap hours, however, quick questions easily stall into two-day email chains." Which sentence best restores logical cohesion at [X]?
opts: In addition, retired postal historians compiled nineteenth-century rail timetables outside hours.

q:
Match each grammatical cohesive device with its exact definition:
1. Anaphoric reference
2. Cataphoric reference
3. Substitution
4. Ellipsis A. Omitting clearly understood repeated words cleanly
B. Replacing a repeated word with "one", "do so", or "so"
C. Opening pointer anticipating information revealed next
D. Pronoun or phrase pointing back to an earlier noun
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Anaphoric reference) → D (Pronoun or phrase pointing back to an earlier noun); 2 (Cataphoric reference) → C (Opening pointer anticipating information revealed next); 3 (Substitution) → B (Replacing a repeated word with "one", "do so", or "so"); 4 (Ellipsis) → A (Omitting clearly understood repeated words cleanly). Grammatik yaxlitlik vositalari: anafora (orqaga), katafora (oldinga), o'rinbosarlik (substitution) va tushirish (ellipsis).
mnemonic: Anaphoric reference / Cataphoric reference / Substitution / Ellipsis

q:
Match each discourse-marker category with its representative connector:
1. Addition
2. Concession
3. Cause and result
4. Exemplification A. Nevertheless / Even so
B. Moreover / Furthermore
C. Consequently / Hence
D. For instance / Specifically
explanation: To'g'ri moslik: 1 (Addition) → B (Moreover / Furthermore); 2 (Concession) → A (Nevertheless / Even so); 3 (Cause and result) → C (Consequently / Hence); 4 (Exemplification) → D (For instance / Specifically). Bog'lovchi toifalari: qo'shish (Moreover), to'siqsizlik (Nevertheless), sabab-oqibat (Consequently), misol (For instance).
mnemonic: Addition / Concession / Cause and result / Exemplification
